profile_text.body:
iFlytek is a Chinese artificial intelligence company founded in 1999 and headquartered in Hefei. The company describes itself as a world-leading AI solution provider in the areas of language exchange and machine learning, with a focus on speech recognition and AI-driven translation technology.

The company's primary AI product is iFlytek Spark, a voice and language AI system that combines speech recognition with large language model capabilities. iFlytek has demonstrated its AI translation solutions at events such as the 2025 Boao Entrepreneur Forum, where it presented work aimed at cross-language communication. Users and observers are advised to consider cross-border data review implications when using the platform.
